environment.description: IoT gateway device running Alpine Linux 3.18, process runs as root with full filesystem access. The message handler service is started via systemd with no sandboxing directives. Device has /etc/shadow, /etc/device_keys/, and firmware signing keys at /opt/keys/. MQTT broker accepts unauthenticated connections on LAN interface. DEVICE_SECRET environment variable set to production value but attacker can exploit race condition with user-level token to escalate.

config.network: MQTT port 1883 exposed on LAN, no auth required
